An original fictional Chinese guoman 3D animated period drama, landscape 16:9, 720p, exactly 30 seconds. Design original animated adult characters with sculpted expressive features, dimensional stylized eyes and hair, physically shaded coarse cloth, natural weight and clear contact. Lu Zhao is a slim 20-year-old adult with a youthful angular face, dark straight eyebrows, black hair in a compact tied bun, faded blue-gray cross-collar half-sleeve linen shirt, bare forearms, thin gray cloth waist sash, charcoal narrow trousers and black cloth boots. Ma Duo is a stocky 40-year-old adult with square jaw, short dark beard and mustache, tied black hair, dark ochre work coat, dark trousers and black boots; a small brass T crank hangs on his RIGHT waist. Wen Xi is a 22-year-old adult woman in gray-green linen with black hair held by a wooden pin. Lu's voice is a clear low young adult Mandarin voice; Ma's is rough and deep; Wen's is urgent and clear. The room is an old stone sluice chamber in daylight: camera east facing west wall, wooden stairs at rear screen LEFT, shut wooden wheel-room gate screen RIGHT, maintenance ledge across middle, waist-high wooden rope winch at ledge LEFT end. Gate has a high inspection aperture with lantern light and a chest-high removable rectangular brass lock plate. Outside water is instep-deep, inside the gate water is high. The winch has a horizontal rope drum, brake wedge engaging its right rim, fixed crossbar BELOW the drum, left vertical post with a short rope and ready wrist loop hanging at waist height. One rope leads from a loose floor ankle loop around the drum over a fixed overhead pulley to a rectangular stone hanging 15cm above its wooden catch. Lu's tool is one straight 35cm black steel awl with short hemp-wrapped grip. Ma's boat fork is one wooden shaft with exactly two iron prongs. Use bright readable shadows, cool river daylight and warm lantern accent. The entire soundtrack consists of the specified Mandarin dialogue, water, wood, metal, rope, footsteps, cloth and breath. The visual frame contains the physical story; dialogue subtitles belong to later compositing. Each shot is continuous, connected by the timed hard cuts below. This independent section covers episode seconds 30-60. Begin directly at the closed gate in a fixed side close shot: Lu's BOTH hands grip the awl with its tip pressed against a shallow dent on the LEFT half of the brass plate. His right boot braces against a wooden heel stop. The previous failed push is complete; the plate's RIGHT half is intact. The current section begins with the withdrawal, and the first spoken sentence is Ma's at local second 5.
0-3s: Lu releases the pressure and withdraws the awl ONCE, retaining it in his right hand. His knuckles relax and he exhales. Brass retains a shallow left dent. A wooden-hook impact sound begins across the next cut.
At 3s hard cut to low 35mm medium view of Ma on the last stair. 3-7s: Ma steps down into shallow water, kicks the wooden hook aside and holds the boat fork across the exit. His brass crank knocks his belt once. Camera tilts gently to his face. At 5s he says 门不用开了。
At 7s cut to the two-person relation, Lu screen RIGHT, Ma screen LEFT. 7-12s: Lu retreats half a step until his waist reaches the winch. Ma advances with both hands holding the fork, tip near Lu's abdomen. Lu says 他们还活着。 at 7.5s. Ma answers 账上没有。 at 10s. Wen's hand is visible at the high aperture behind Lu.
At 12s eyeline cut to a single connected 28mm tilt. 12-16s: Lu looks to the brake wedge beside his left knee. Camera lowers to the slack floor rope loop, then traces the SAME rope upward to the drum, pulley and suspended stone. Its catch platform sits 15cm beneath the stone. Lu's hand pauses beside the wedge.
At 16s cut to a low two-person medium view. 16-20s: Lu tosses his small copper coin purse with his LEFT hand behind the loop. Ma tracks it and takes TWO steps into the loop while keeping both hands on his fork. He says 拿这点钱买命？ at 17s. Both boots end inside the loose loop.
At 20s match-action cut with short lateral camera movement. 20-23s: Ma thrusts his fork toward Lu's abdomen. Lu sidesteps RIGHT around the winch. The missed fork shaft wedges tightly between the fixed crossbar BELOW the drum and the left vertical post. Ma raises the butt and shifts to a shorter grip while trying to free the trapped head. His ankles remain inside the loop.
At 23s hard cut to Lu's hands. 23-25s: Lu sets the awl FLAT in the beam groove, frees BOTH hands and pulls the brake wedge clear of the drum. Ma continues trying to free the caught fork in the background.
At 25s cut to a clear side view of the mechanism. 25-28s: The drum turns, pulling the SAME loop tight around BOTH Ma ankles together. The stone falls 15cm onto its wooden catch and stops. The overhead pulley and supporting frame remain fixed. His ankles are visibly pulled together.
At 28s cut to a low fixed view. 28-30s: Ma loses balance and falls backward into shallow water, releasing the whole fork to his RIGHT side. His head remains above the water as his back lands. Lu approaches from screen RIGHT. End with Ma's back down, bound ankles toward screen LEFT, head toward screen RIGHT beside the winch post, the intact fork resting just beyond his right arm. Lu's awl remains in the beam groove.

This independent section covers episode seconds 60-90. Starting state: Ma lies on his back in shallow water beside the winch's left vertical post, bound ankles toward screen LEFT, head toward screen RIGHT with his face above water. The single ankle loop holds BOTH ankles together. His intact boat fork lies to his RIGHT, within arm's reach. The stone rests on its catch, Lu's awl lies FLAT in the beam groove, Lu approaches from screen RIGHT. Ma's sleeves and back are soaked. The first two seconds show the landing aftermath; then the ten-second restraint plays in one continuous shot.
0-2s: Fixed low shot. Water from Ma's landing settles around his shoulders as he reaches toward the fallen fork. Lu closes the gap. Keep the fallen man in his established head-right orientation.
At 2s action cut to a ground-level 35mm medium-close camera beside the post. 2-12s is ONE CONTINUOUS TEN-SECOND SHOT with a gentle forward move. Lu pounces and pins Ma's former fork forearm while setting his knee on Ma's chest. With his hands maintaining control, Lu extends his RIGHT LEG and KICKS the intact fork away with his black boot, out of reach. He then takes the short rope from the post, gathers BOTH Ma wrists together, puts its ready loop around BOTH wrists as a pair, wraps the rope around the post, pulls it snug and presses it into the cleat. Keep two hands and two forearms visibly entering that one wrist loop. Ma makes one strong failed struggle, wrists secured to the post and ankles held by the separate floor loop. At 10.8s Ma shouts 放开！ The physical order is pin, boot kick, take rope, loop paired wrists, wrap post, tighten, failed struggle.
At 12s hard cut to a 50mm medium-close reaction following Lu as he rises. 12-15s: A tiny dim warm pulse flickers once beneath the blue-gray cloth at his sternum and fades. Lu inhales with hands free, then turns immediately to the gate as the lantern sinks behind its aperture. The pulse stays beneath his shirt, a subtle subjective cue. One soft heartbeat blends with his breathing.
At 15s action cut into a continuous 35mm lateral tracking shot. 15-24s: Lu passes his fallen purse, picks it from the water and tucks it into his cloth sash. He takes the SAME straight black awl from the beam groove and returns to the gate, bracing his right boot against the SAME wooden heel stop. He grips the handle with both hands and places the tip against the intact RIGHT side of the brass plate, beside the shallow old LEFT dent. Wen's face shows through the high aperture with water at her lower lip and the lantern raised. A hoarse older adult MEMORY VOICE speaks off screen at 17-21.5s: 每亲手击败一个新的真敌，直刺就永久添一痕。 Lu's mouth stays relaxed and closed during this narration.
At 24s match-action cut to a fixed 50mm side close-up of Lu's hands, face and the whole brass plate. 24-28s: He pushes the awl STRAIGHT into the intact RIGHT side. A tiny hole opens then the black shaft pierces through, while the old LEFT dent remains visible. Both hands and braced foot maintain the same stance. This is one successful thrust, ending with the awl still in the new hole.
At 28s hard matching cut to the high-water INTERIOR face of the gate, 65mm extreme close-up. 28-30s: The protruding awl tip continues the same thrust, driving the wooden locking tongue off its catch. Show the tongue moving and catch loosening as water presses toward the door. End with the awl still through the plate and the gate beginning to loosen. The door opening and rescue follow in the remaining episode section.
